name: azure-tf-author
description: Plan-only Terraform authoring companion for Azure. Writes, reviews and refactors azurerm and azapi code to a stated standard and validates it without applying.

interface.shortDescription: Plan-only Terraform authoring and review for Azure.
interface.longDescription: Writes, reviews and refactors Terraform for Azure to a stated standard: module and state boundaries, typed interfaces, Azure naming and tagging, managed identities, private networking and secure defaults. Checks arguments against the pinned azurerm version and validates with plan-only commands; never applies or destroys infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Author a private storage account module for Azure.
Review this Azure Terraform against the standard.
Import these Azure resources without replacing them.
